title: Rich man and Lazarus: deed or type of judgment?
english: 8. There was a rich man, feasting splendidly each day; and a poor man, Lazarus, was cast at his gate, covered with sores, according to the Gospel history (Luke 16:19-23). Both died: the poor man went to rest, the other to punishment. Have these things already happened, and was a fitting repayment allotted to each — or does the story stamp the image of the coming judgment…
translator_notes: True OET from PG 77 / Vat. gr. 447 Greek; Pass A ≠ Pass B.
Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify; skip Pusey-PD / Greystone / Lunn / Hill.

title: Lazarus named so the deed is shown true
english: …in these things? But, someone says, when he names the appellation Lazarus, it truly happened and was done. Why did he not say a certain poor man, but Lazarus? title: Hosea’s wife and Melchizedek’s origin
english: …begot children from her in deed and energy, or does he speak things understood prophetically? title: Look to Hosea and Genesis on Melchizedek
english: …prophet Hosea, and in the book on Genesis much examination is found concerning Melchizedek; and it is open to your piety to meet with the books and take from there the sense of what was said on each.
